name: Lemon Wookie #4
flavor: Sweet lemon, diesel, bright citrus peel.
effects: Hybrid-leaning sativa uplift with clean citrus energy.
accolades: Cup-winning sativa cut, loved for its loud citrus profile.
review: "My go-to daytime smoke when I still want to get things done."
notes: Sharp lemon and diesel funk with energetic daytime vibes.

name: Lilac Diesel
lineage: Silver Lemon Haze x Forbidden Fruit x NYC Diesel
effects: Sativa clarity, euphoria, and gentle body buzz.
accolades: High Times Cup winner and Dutch Touch fan favorite.
review: "Flower that smells like a jar of purple gas — and smokes even better."
notes: A floral, gassy sativa with a clean, uplifting head high.

name: Mr. Clean
accolades: Cup-winning medical sativa, legendary at Dutch Touch.
review: "The only thing I want to do after smoking this is crush my to-do list."
notes: Bright citrus and pine with a sharp, focused, get-things-done energy.

name: Space Hippy
effects: Sativa-leaning hybrid float, creativity, and calm.
accolades: Cup-winning hybrid, a staple in Dutch Touch jars.
review: "Perfect for music, movies, and losing track of time in the best way."
notes: A funky, fruity hybrid that floats between a heady buzz and body melt.

name: Death By Funk
effects: Sedating, heavy, couch-lock with thunderous head change.
accolades: Awarded for its nose and knockout power.
review: "The name is not a joke. This is lights-out funk."
notes: Loud funk-driven hybrid built for late nights and heavy sessions.

name: Forbidden Jelly
accolades: Cup-winning dessert indica with serious bag appeal.
review: "Looks like candy, smells like jam, hits like an indica should."
notes: Dessert-style indica with sweet berry jelly notes and deep relaxation.

name: Death Star
accolades: Classic heavy hitter for nighttime sessions.
review: "One of those strains that makes the room go quiet in a good way."
notes: Classic diesel indica with a heavy, immersive body stone.

name: Clusterfunk
accolades: A throwback jar for old heads and new fans.
review: "Smells like the early 2000s in the best possible way."
notes: Throwback indica with classic hash and gas flavor for everyday sessions.

name: Pina Rita
effects: Sativa-leaning hybrid buzz, mood-lifting and social.
review: "Tastes like pineapple gummies and makes everything more fun."
notes: Tropical pineapple and citrus with a vacation-style buzz.

name: 10K
review: "Two hits and I was exactly where I wanted to be."
notes: High-impact sativa built for experienced heads.

name: Fruit Brute
review: "Makes everything taste better and puts a grin on my face."

name: Big Smooth
accolades: Comfort strain for evenings and slow weekends.
review: "It’s like a berry milkshake in flower form."
notes: Creamy dessert hybrid with a mellow, floaty high.

name: Angelica
accolades: For people who like straight gas in the morning.
review: "Feels like a strong coffee with extra flavor."
notes: Gas-forward indica built for active but grounded days.

name: Old Widow
effects: Indica calm with classic couchy vibes.

name: Chocolate Marshmallow

name: White Wampa

name: Illudium

name: Apollo
